entries.back_en: "No problem, Sister. Besides... If Chino knows what happened to my sister, I'll do whatever it takes to make him tell me!"
"Hmm... Mr. Marlok? What exactly do you want me to do?"
"Excuse me, Mr. Marlok? Is there something you'd like me to do?"
"The Wyndian princess visited us a short time ago. She made a fine donation of clothes and toys for the children."
"Yes, Sister Lyta. These people were kind enough to help me."
"There is nothing to tell! The Empire invited the Princess to go to the capital!"
"Very good, Miss [04]... Now how about a back massage?"
"I heard the guy before me lost to a bunch of kids. I don't hold back, no matter who I fight. If you think you can take me on, you're wrong! Want to try your luck?" You bet! / Are you kidding?

Marlok "... You again. So, how's the journey? Instead of wandering around, how about looking for some treasure? If you show me interesting items, maybe I could be persuaded to teach some of my business secrets." Show treasure / Never mind
"Anything else?" Begin apprenticeship / Quit apprenticeship / Never mind
